en.headline: Centre for Health Protection records two imported chikungunya and one dengue case
en.dek: The two chikungunya patients had visited the mainland during the incubation period; the dengue case was linked to travel in Cambodia. Both diseases remain mostly imported this year.
body: The Centre for Health Protection reported on Friday two imported cases of chikungunya fever and one imported case of dengue fever recorded in recent days.

The chikungunya cases involved two men who had visited the mainland during the incubation period. The centre believes both were infected while overseas. A 17-year-old patient has recovered and been discharged; a 64-year-old remains in stable condition under treatment in a mosquito-free environment. The cases have been notified to mainland health authorities.
Separately, one imported dengue case was recorded between 9 and 15 October in a patient who had visited Cambodia. The city has recorded 34 dengue cases this year, the large majority imported.
Hong Kong has so far recorded seven confirmed chikungunya cases in 2026, of which six were imported and one was local.

zh.headline: 衛生防護中心錄得兩宗輸入性基孔肯雅熱及一宗登革熱個案
zh.dek: 兩名基孔肯雅熱患者潛伏期內曾到內地，登革熱個案與柬埔寨行程有關，今年個案大多為外地傳入。
body: 衛生防護中心周五表示，本月9日至昨日新增一宗外地傳入登革熱個案，病人潛伏期內到過柬埔寨。今年累計錄得34宗登革熱個案，大多為輸入。
另外，過去一星期錄得兩宗外地傳入基孔肯雅熱個案，涉及兩名男子，潛伏期內均曾到過內地。中心認為兩人均在外遊期間感染。17歲患者已康復出院，64歲患者情況穩定，在無蚊環境下接受治療。個案已通報內地衛生當局。
本港今年暫時累計錄得7宗基孔肯雅熱確診個案，包括6宗輸入及1宗本地個案。
中心提醒市民外遊時採取防蚊措施，回港後如有發燒等病徵應盡快求醫並告知外遊史。
